key_rationale: With headline CPI at 7.44% significantly breaching the upper tolerance band and food inflation surging to 11.51%, we must remain vigilant against the risk of unanchored inflation expectations. Given the positive output gap of 0.60% and the necessity of aligning banking system liquidity with our policy objective, maintaining the current stance is essential to ensure a durable disinflationary path toward the 4.00% target.
